name: Default
shortDescription: Share passwords and other sensitive text through encrypted links that self-destruct after a single view, backed by Valkey.

alerts.message: Create the first admin account from the app container console with: bin/ots customers create you@example.com --role colonel (it prints a generated password). Open signup is on and accounts are verified without email; set AUTH_SIGNUP to false to close it.
Back up the generated SECRET value. Losing or changing it makes every stored secret unreadable.
